text:
Nothing remains of you... the abyss sank you...

the monsters of the seas swallowed you.

In those funereal places not even

your own bones are left of you.

Easy to understand, beloved Alberto,

is that you lost your life in the sea,

but the grieving soul cannot understand

how I live when you have died.

To give life to me and death to you;

to give peace to you and war to me,

to leave you in the sea and me on land

is fate's greatest cruelty!!




1848

translation.title: Nothing Remains of You
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the elegy's direct accusation against fate after Alberto's death at sea.
